+def _mla_config(**overrides):
+    config = dict(
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        q_lora_rank=32,
+        kv_lora_rank=32,
+        qk_head_dim=16,
+        qk_pos_emb_head_dim=16,
+        v_head_dim=16,
+        rope_type="rope",
+        apply_rope_fusion=False,
+        add_bias_linear=False,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+        transformer_impl="local",
+    )
+    config.update(overrides)
+    return MLATransformerConfig(**config)
+
+
+_MLA_LINEARS = [
+    "linear_q_down_proj",
+    "linear_q_up_proj",
+    "linear_kv_down_proj",
+    "linear_kv_up_proj",
+    "linear_proj",
+]
+_MLA_LINEARS_WITHOUT_Q_LORA = [
+    "linear_q_proj",
+    "linear_kv_down_proj",
+    "linear_kv_up_proj",
+    "linear_proj",
+]
+
+
+def _build_mla(
+    pg_collection, *, column_linear, row_linear, down_linear, attention_cls, **config_overrides
+):
+    """Build MLA or absorbed MLA; return it and the names of the linears it builds."""
+    config = _mla_config(**config_overrides)
+    submodules_cls = (
+        AbsorbedMLASelfAttentionSubmodules
+        if attention_cls is AbsorbedMLASelfAttention
+        else MLASelfAttentionSubmodules
+    )
+    submodules = submodules_cls(
+        linear_q_proj=column_linear,
+        linear_q_down_proj=down_linear,
+        linear_q_up_proj=column_linear,
+        linear_kv_down_proj=down_linear,
+        linear_kv_up_proj=column_linear,
+        core_attention=_CoreAttention,
+        linear_proj=row_linear,
+        q_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+        kv_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+    )
+    module = attention_cls(
+        config=config,
+        submodules=submodules,
+        layer_number=1,
+        attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+    )
+    return module, (_MLA_LINEARS if config.q_lora_rank is not None else _MLA_LINEARS_WITHOUT_Q_LORA)
+
+
+def _build_fused_mla(pg_collection, *, column_linear, row_linear, down_linear, **config_overrides):
+    submodules = MLASelfAttentionSubmodules(
+        linear_qkv_down_proj=down_linear,
+        linear_q_up_proj=column_linear,
+        linear_kv_up_proj=column_linear,
+        core_attention=_CoreAttention,
+        linear_proj=row_linear,
+        q_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+        kv_layernorm=IdentityOp,
+    )
+    module = FusedMLASelfAttention(
+        config=_mla_config(**config_overrides),
+        submodules=submodules,
+        layer_number=1,
+        attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+        pg_collection=pg_collection,
+    )
+    return module, ["linear_qkv_down_proj", "linear_q_up_proj", "linear_kv_up_proj", "linear_proj"]
+
+
+def _build_cross_attention(pg_collection, *, column_linear, row_linear):
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1, hidden_size=64, num_attention_heads=4, use_cpu_initialization=True
+    )
+    submodules = CrossAttentionSubmodules(
+        linear_q=column_linear,
+        linear_kv=column_linear,
+        core_attention=_CoreAttention,
+        linear_proj=row_linear,
+    )
+    module = CrossAttention(
+        config=config, submodules=submodules, layer_number=1, pg_collection=pg_collection
+    )
+    return module, ["linear_q", "linear_kv", "linear_proj"]
+
+
+def _build_dsa_indexer(pg_collection, *, linear, norm):
+    config = _mla_config(
+        dsa_indexer_n_heads=4,
+        dsa_indexer_head_dim=32,
+        dsa_indexer_topk=8,
+        dsa_indexer_loss_coeff=1.0,
+    )
+    submodules = DSAIndexerSubmodules(
+        linear_wq_b=linear, linear_wk=linear, k_norm=norm, linear_weights_proj=linear
+    )
+    module = DSAIndexer(config, submodules, pg_collection)
+    return module, ["linear_wq_b", "linear_wk", "linear_weights_proj"]
+

+def _build_simplified_dsa_indexer(pg_collection, *, linear, norm):
+    del norm
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=32,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        num_query_groups=1,
+        kv_channels=8,

+        add_bias_linear=False,

+        dsa_indexer_mode="simplified",
+        dsa_indexer_topk=4,
+        dsa_kernel_backend="min-memory-torch",

+    module = SimplifiedDSGQAIndexer(config, submodules, pg_collection=pg_collection)
+    return module, ["linear_q", "linear_k"]

+def _build_csa_indexer(pg_collection, *, linear, norm):
+    config = _mla_config(
+        v_head_dim=32,
+        multi_latent_attention=True,
+        csa_compress_ratios=[4],
+        csa_window_size=8,
+        dsa_indexer_n_heads=4,
+        dsa_indexer_head_dim=32,

+"""apply_rotary_pos_emb uses the context-parallel group its caller passes.
+
+Only packed (THD) sequences read the group. When the caller omits it for them, RoPE warns and
+falls back to the global context-parallel group, as before.

+import warnings

+
+VERSIONS = "deprecated since Megatron Core 0.21 and will be removed in 0.23"
+
+# Two packed sequences of 16 tokens each. With context parallelism of size 2, every rank holds
+# 8 tokens of each sequence.
+CU_SEQLENS = (0, 16, 32)
+LOCAL_TOKENS = 16
+HEADS, DIM = 2, 8
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def fresh_warning_registry(monkeypatch):
+    """Each test observes the first fallback warning of every owner."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(process_groups_config, "_warned_global_process_group_fallbacks", set())
+
+
+def _config():
+    return TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1, hidden_size=HEADS * DIM, num_attention_heads=HEADS, apply_rope_fusion=False
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs():
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1234)
+    t = torch.randn(LOCAL_TOKENS, HEADS, DIM, device="cuda", generator=generator)
+    freqs = torch.randn(CU_SEQLENS[-1], 1, 1, DIM, device="cuda", generator=generator)
+    cu_seqlens = torch.tensor(CU_SEQLENS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return t, freqs, cu_seqlens
+
+
+def _pairs_cp_group():
+    """A context-parallel group of adjacent rank pairs, which the global grid does not have."""
+    world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+    group, _ = torch.distributed.new_subgroups_by_enumeration(
+        [[rank, rank + 1] for rank in range(0, world_size, 2)]
+    )
+    return group
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(Utils.world_size < 2 or Utils.world_size % 2, reason="needs an even world")

+            )

+        global_cp = rope_utils._apply_rotary_pos_emb_thd(
+            t, cu_seqlens, freqs, cp_group=parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        assert not torch.equal(output, global_cp)
+        torch.distributed.destroy_process_group(cp_group)

+"""Sharded state dicts compute replica ids over the DP x CP group of the module that builds them.
+
+Called without metadata, ``sharded_state_dict`` used to fill in the global
+``get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)``. A model on its own grid then claimed
+replicas by another grid's DP ranks, so several ranks or none wrote each shard.
+"""
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core import parallel_state, process_groups_config
+from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.dict_utils import nested_values
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import TransformerBlock
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import (
+    ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group,
+    make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import (
+    make_sharded_tensor_for_checkpoint,
+    make_tp_sharded_tensor_for_checkpoint,
+)
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+def _read_global_data_parallel_group(*args, **kwargs):
+    raise AssertionError("read the global data-parallel group")
+
+
+class _ParallelStateWithoutGlobalDpCpGroup:
+    """``parallel_state`` as the collection shim sees it, without the global DP x CP group.
+
+    The shim binds a getter for every field and calls only the requested ones, so the data-parallel
+    getter raises when it is called, and requests for other fields still resolve.
+    """
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name):
+        if name == 'get_data_parallel_group':
+            return _read_global_data_parallel_group
+        return getattr(parallel_state, name)
+
+
+def forbid_global_dp_cp_group():
+    """Make reads of the global data-parallel group through the collection shim raise.
+
+    The DP x CP fallbacks of the checkpoint helpers read the group there.
+    """
+    return mock.patch.object(
+        process_groups_config, 'parallel_state', _ParallelStateWithoutGlobalDpCpGroup()
+    )
+
+
+def shard_ids(sharded_state_dict):
+    """``(key, global_offset, replica_id)`` of every sharded entry, sorted."""
+    return sorted(
+        (entry.key, getattr(entry, 'global_offset', None), entry.replica_id)
+        for entry in nested_values(sharded_state_dict)
+    )
+
+
+class TestEnsureMetadataHasDpCpGroup:
+
+    def test_fills_missing_metadata_with_the_given_group(self):
+        group = object()
+        metadata = {'singleton_local_shards': True}

+def _fallback_warning(record, owner, argument="pg_collection"):
+    """Return the only fallback warning in ``record``, after checking that it names ``owner``."""
+    fallbacks = [w for w in record if issubclass(w.category, ProcessGroupFallbackWarning)]
+    assert [str(w.message).split(" was called")[0] for w in fallbacks] == [owner]
+    message = str(fallbacks[0].message)
+    assert message.startswith(f"{owner} was called without `{argument}`")
+    assert _VERSIONS in message
+    # The warning points at the code that omitted the argument.
+    assert fallbacks[0].filename == __file__
+    return fallbacks[0]

+def _forbid_global_process_groups(monkeypatch):
+    """Make the global group, rank and size accessors and the global collection raise.
+
+    By-name imports of an accessor in other Megatron Core modules are patched as well.
+    """
+
+    def forbid(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("read the global process groups")
+
+    suffixes = ("_group", "_groups", "_gloo", "_rank", "_ranks", "_world_size")
+    accessors = {
+        name: getattr(parallel_state, name)
+        for name in dir(parallel_state)
+        if name.startswith("get_") and name.endswith(suffixes) and name != "get_all_ranks"
+    }
+    originals = {id(accessor) for accessor in accessors.values()}
+    for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
+        if getattr(module, "__name__", "").startswith("megatron.core"):
+            for name, value in list(vars(module).items()):
+                if id(value) in originals:
+                    monkeypatch.setattr(module, name, forbid)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ProcessGroupCollection, "use_mpu_process_groups", forbid)

+    if "mtp_num_layers" in kwargs:
+        kwargs.setdefault("mtp_loss_scaling_factor", 1.0)
+    return TransformerConfig(use_cpu_initialization=True, **kwargs)
